0022600178.text: The Pacers (2-6, 0-4 at home) visit the Grizzlies (6-0, 2-0 at home), who have won six straight and sit first in the West and the Southwest. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, and in their last meeting Memphis beat Indiana 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series the Pacers lost 0-2.
